steps.label: Why change now?
steps.talkTrack: Find commercial triggers before defining technology scope

steps.label: Discover fragmented signals
steps.talkTrack: Map source systems and their custodians; separate estimated from observed data

steps.label: Build buying coalition
steps.talkTrack: Connect the CFO, estates, energy, facilities, workplace and IT/OT interests

steps.label: Validate the economic case
steps.talkTrack: Define counterfactual, attribution, investment envelope and measurable metrics

steps.label: Monetise orchestration
steps.talkTrack: Separate advisory, integration, software and managed-service revenue from customer benefits

steps.label: Architect the enabling layer
steps.talkTrack: Make Cisco relevance explicit without implying ownership of BMS or specialist controls

steps.label: Roadmap to governed operations
steps.talkTrack: Begin with recommendations and supervised workflows; keep safety systems independently authorised
